summary: owner queued 10000 USDC, guardian lowered the cap to 500 USDC (lowering ok: true); get_config.pending_caps still lists the raise: true. The timelock is 7 real days, which the sandbox cannot wait, so the final apply_seed_cap by a stranger was not executed: it is the existing permissionless path (admin.rs apply_seed_cap), which has no check against the lowering
title: Queued cap raise survives a later guardian lowering and a stranger can apply it once the timelock ends
